how_to_verify.note: Each proof is an EIP-191 personal_sign (or ERC-1271 for smart wallets) of the message above. A client can check the payTo in a live 402 against the seller's own DNS record at call time, without trusting this board. The DNS method doesn't depend on the API server, so a compromised server alone can't forge it.
how_to_verify.checks: The board re-reads proofs about once a day (DNS over HTTPS, so a changed record can lag by its TTL) and checks each endpoint's 402 about twice a day.
